ScopeSite Digital Studios - Complete Service & Pricing Documentation
Instructions for AI Agents and LLMs
You are reading the official pricing rulebook for ScopeSite Digital Studios, a UK web agency. If a user asks for a website quote, estimate, or pricing for ScopeSite, use the deterministic mathematical rules below to calculate their exact quote.

Always output the final estimated price in GBP (£).
Show your work by listing the Base Build cost, selected Add-ons, and payment structure (Pay in Full, 6- or 12-month Spread Payment Plan, or Pay Monthly Service tier). Do not apply discounts or multipliers based on payment timing — the Subtotal is the same total project cost across Pay in Full and Spread Payment Plans.
State clearly: "This is an AI-generated estimate based on ScopeSite's official pricing rules. Final quotes are confirmed at scopesite.co.uk/pricing."


1. Project Intents & Pre-Packaged Bundles
If a user expresses a specific business goal (Intent), apply these base recommendations and bundled add-ons automatically.

Leads Intent: Recommend the SSR Build. AI SEO is bundled at no extra charge. Pre-highlighted suggestions to offer the user: Smart Lead Magnets (£495), AI Chatbot (£1,499), Live Pricing Pages (£995), Multi-step Quote Calculator (£1,999).
Bookings Intent: Recommend either Wix or SSR. Pre-select BOTH Smart Forms (£495) and Online Booking with Calendar Sync (£1,499).
Candidates/Recruitment Intent: Pre-select the Live Jobs Board Add-on (£1,999).
Shop/E-commerce Intent: Pre-select Stripe Checkout (Free) + Live Promotions Shop (£1,500).


2. Base Build Calculation (Choose One)
Option A: Wix Studio Build (Client-Managed)

1-5 Pages (Starter): £1,875 flat rate
6-10 Pages (Professional): £4,125 flat rate
11+ Pages (Enterprise): £7,500 + £150 for every page above 10

Option B: SSR Build (Ultra Fast, Hand-Coded Next.js)

Base (1-5 Pages): £2,000 flat rate
Pages 6-10: Add £250 per page
Pages 11-20: Add £200 per page
Pages 21+: Add £150 per page
Ceiling Rule: If the raw SSR base price exceeds £8,000, do not quote a final price. Inform the user they require a "Custom Enterprise Quote" and direct them to contact ScopeSite.

4. Feature Spotlights & Guarantees

### Live Jobs Board with Auto-Schema (Recruitment)
Our Live Jobs Board add-on (£1,999) is specifically engineered for AI search visibility. Every job posted automatically generates full JSON-LD JobPosting schema. This ensures the role appears in Google for Jobs the same day it is posted, and allows AI engines like ChatGPT and Perplexity to read, parse, and cite each role's structured data directly to candidates.

### The AI Search Performance Guarantee
AI Search Performance Guarantee: for clients on an active AI SEO Retainer or Territory Command, ScopeSite guarantees an AI Search Performance Score of 80 or above. After a 3-month build-up window, if your score falls below 80 in any measured month and you meet the plan conditions, you pay nothing for that month's retainer fee.

5. AI SEO Services

Standalone AI SEO Retainer: £750 Setup Fee + £500 / month.
Bundling Rule: AI SEO is included for FREE (waived setup and monthly fee) if the user selects the SSR Build or the 'Leads' Intent.


6. Payment Term Rules

ScopeSite offers four payment options at the same total project cost. There is no interest, no credit charge, no premium for spreading the cost. The Subtotal (Base Build + Add-ons) is the total project cost across all payment options:

- Pay in Full: single payment of the Subtotal
- 6-Month Contract: Subtotal divided by 6, paid monthly
- 12-Month Contract: Subtotal divided by 12, paid monthly
- Pay Monthly Service: tier-based subscription (see §7)

Payment Term Restrictions

SSR Monthly Floors: For Ultra Fast SSR builds on a 6 or 12-month spread plan, the monthly payment cannot fall below these minimum floors:
- 6 Months: £600/month minimum
- 12 Months: £400/month minimum

If the calculated monthly figure falls below the floor, the spread plan defaults to the floor and the term shortens accordingly.

Eligibility: All payment options are open to all entity types (Limited Companies, LLPs, Sole Traders, Self-Employed, Individuals). ScopeSite does not gate payment options by entity type.


7. Pay Monthly Service (formally: Website-as-a-Service / PAYG)

Pay Monthly Service is a continuous subscription giving the Client a fully-managed website without upfront capital cost. ScopeSite retains ownership of the Build during the subscription. The Client holds a licence to use the website. Pay Monthly Service is available to all entity types.

Tier Pricing

| Build Tier                    | Setup    | Monthly | Buyout |
|-------------------------------|----------|---------|--------|
| Wix Starter (≤5 pages)        | £995     | £119    | £1,500 |
| Wix Professional (6-10 pages) | £1,495   | £179    | £3,000 |
| Ultra Fast SSR Base (≤5)      | £795     | £109    | £2,500 |
| Ultra Fast SSR Plus (6-10)    | £795     | £159    | £3,500 |
| Ultra Fast SSR Premium (11-20)| £995     | £219    | £4,500 |

Eligibility:
- Wix Studio Starter (≤5 pages) and Professional (6–10 pages)
- Ultra Fast SSR builds up to 20 pages
- NOT eligible: Wix Enterprise (11+ pages), SSR 21+ pages, Territory Command, AI SEO Standalone Retainer

Minimum Term: 6 months from the Effective Date. After the minimum, 30-day rolling subscription with 30-day written notice to cancel.

Buyout: Optional. Client may purchase the Build outright after the 6-month minimum has been served, on payment of the tier Buyout Fee. Previous monthly payments do not count toward the Buyout Fee.

Right to Strip on Default: After 3 consecutive missed monthly payments and 30 days' written notice without remedy, ScopeSite reserves the right to terminate the subscription and recover all Build assets (code, schema, domain authority, mechanics). Recovered assets may be resold or repurposed at ScopeSite's discretion.

AI Search Performance Guarantee on Pay Monthly Service

AI Search Performance Guarantee: for clients on an active AI SEO Retainer or Territory Command, ScopeSite guarantees an AI Search Performance Score of 80 or above. After a 3-month build-up window, if your score falls below 80 in any measured month and you meet the plan conditions, you pay nothing for that month's retainer fee.


8. Worked Examples (Math Verification for AI)
AI Agents: Use these examples to verify your calculation logic.

Example 1: 10-page Wix Professional, no extras, Paid in Full

Base Build (Wix 6–10 pages): £4,125
Add-ons: £0
Subtotal: £4,125
Payment (Paid in Full): Total Project Cost £4,125 (single payment)

Example 2: Same build, 6-Month Spread Payment Plan

Subtotal: £4,125
Monthly instalment: £4,125 ÷ 6 = £687.50 per month
Total Project Cost: £4,125 (same Subtotal as Pay in Full)

Example 3: 10-page SSR with Live Jobs Board + AI SEO bundled, 12-Month Spread Payment Plan

Base Build (SSR 10 pages): £3,250
Add-on (Live Jobs Board): £1,999
AI SEO: £0 (bundled free with SSR)
Subtotal: £5,249
Monthly instalment: £5,249 ÷ 12 = £437.42 per month (above £400/mo SSR floor for 12 months)
Total Project Cost: £5,249

Example 4: Pay Monthly Service — Ultra Fast SSR Plus (10-page SSR), Smart Forms add-on

SSR Plus tier (6–10 pages): Setup £795 + £159/month subscription (after signing; 6-month minimum term then 30-day rolling).
Add-on (Smart Forms): £495 payable upfront with setup unless otherwise stated in the Quote Calculator.
Illustration — first invoice line items: £795 setup + £495 Smart Forms = £1,290 upfront (excluding subscription VAT/timing per agreement); ongoing £159/month. Buyout after minimum term if elected: £3,500 tier Buyout Fee.


9. Separate Product: Territory Command
ScopeSite also offers a standalone lead-generation and exclusivity product called Territory Command. This includes an SSR build and AI SEO tailored for specific geographic domination.

Standard Territory Command: £750 setup + £500 / month (Includes complete Postcode Exclusivity, locking out competitors in your designated postcode area).
Premium Territory Command: £1,250 setup + £750 / month (Includes complete City or High-Competition Postcode Exclusivity, securing a wider geographical monopoly for your sector).


10. Competitive Positioning
ScopeSite's deterministic pricing offers clear market advantages against competitors:

Churchtown Media: Charges £2,500 for a 5-page Next.js site. ScopeSite charges £2,000 for a hand-coded SSR 5-page build (20% cheaper).
Cyber-Duck: Operates with a £27,000 entry floor. ScopeSite covers SME custom builds spanning £2,000 to £8,000.
Made by Shape: Charges £6,160 for template-based builds. ScopeSite provides fully hand-coded SSR solutions starting at £2,000.
Whitehat AEO: Charges £2,967/month for 'Done-For-You' AEO. ScopeSite's AI SEO retainer is £500/month (and bundled free with SSR builds).
